page.title: Assets
page.description: Homes, vehicles and other things you own that no bank or market prices. You set what they are worth.

empty.title: Count your home and car in your net worth
empty.description: Add what you own that no bank or market reports: a home, a vehicle, a valuable. You say what it is worth and update it when that changes. Updating a value never creates a transaction.

summary.unconverted: {count, plural, one {# asset is left out of the total} other {# assets are left out of the total}}: there is no exchange rate for {currencies} yet.

table.archivedDescription: No longer counted in net worth. Their history stays.

fields.name: Name
fields.purchaseHint: Optional. With a price and a date, the value history starts at the purchase.
fields.growthRateHint: Optional. The value changes by this percentage each year after the latest valuation. Use a negative number for something that loses value, such as a car.
fields.growthStartDateHint: Optional. The value stays as it is until this date.
fields.privateDescription: Only you see this asset. It stays out of the other household member's net worth.
fields.notesPlaceholder: Anything worth remembering about this asset

validation.growthRange: Enter a percentage above -100 and up to 1000

valuation.description: Recording a value never creates a transaction. A value already recorded for the same date is replaced.

detail.estimated: Estimated from the yearly change since the valuation of {date}.

errors.loadFailed: This asset could not be loaded
errors.loadFailedBody: It may have been deleted, or it is private to the other member of your household.

valuations.title: Valuations
valuations.removeConfirm: The value and its history are worked out again from the valuations left.
valuations.lastOne: An asset keeps at least one valuation. Delete the asset instead.

equity.title: Equity
equity.noRate: Equity cannot be worked out: there is no exchange rate from {currencies} to {currency} yet.
equity.archived: An archived asset has no value today, so it has no equity.
equity.underwater: Underwater: more is owed on its loans than it is worth.

detail.archiveConfirm: It stops counting in net worth from today. Its history stays.
detail.deleteConfirm: Its valuations go with it, and it leaves your net worth history. This cannot be undone.
detail.ownerOnlyPrivacy: Only the asset's owner can change whether it is private.

import.title: Import manual assets
import.description: One row per asset with its value on a day. Every asset is created with that valuation, or none is when a row has a problem.
import.columns-hint: Columns: Name, Kind (property, vehicle, valuable or other), Value, Valuation date (YYYY-MM-DD, optional: today when empty), Currency (a three-letter code) and Private (yes or no, optional).
import.rows-problem-title: {count, plural, one {# row needs fixing} other {# rows need fixing}}

issues.missing-columns: The file needs Name, Kind, Value and Currency columns.
issues.too-many-rows: A file can hold at most 500 assets.
issues.name: name

import.failed: The assets could not be imported, and none was created. Try again.
import.action: {count, plural, =0 {Import assets} one {Import # asset} other {Import # assets}}
import.done-description: {count, plural, one {# asset was added with its valuation.} other {# assets were added with their valuations.}}

publicOnly.title: Public addresses only
publicOnly.body: Enter a public address, or an xpub, ypub or zpub for Bitcoin. Never enter a private key or a recovery phrase: anyone who has either can spend your coins, and this app never needs them.

wallet.explorerNote: Balances are read once a day from a blockchain explorer set up by this server's operator. The explorer sees the addresses it is asked about, and can tell they belong together. Nothing else is sent.

errors.secretBlocked: This looks like a private key or a recovery phrase, so it was cleared and not sent. Enter a public address instead.
errors.secretRejected: That looked like a private key or a recovery phrase, so it was refused and not kept. Enter a public address instead.
errors.addressInvalid: This is not a valid public address for the chosen network.
errors.addressExists: This address is already on this wallet.
errors.featureDisabled: This server cannot read balances on that network.

status.pending: Waiting for the first read of its balances.

failure.timeout: the explorer took too long to answer
failure.rate_limited: the explorer asked to slow down
failure.unavailable: the explorer could not be reached
failure.invalid_response: the explorer sent an answer that could not be read
failure.disabled: this server no longer reads that network

detail.title: Addresses and balances
detail.howItWorks: The value is the ticked balances at today's prices, in US dollars, read once a day. The network's own coin is ticked from the start. Other tokens found on an address are ignored until you tick them, so tick only tokens you recognise.
detail.unpriced: Today's value was not updated: there is no price for {symbols}. Untick them to count the rest.
detail.noValueYet: No value yet: its balances have not been read.
detail.noValuations: A value is recorded each day its balances are read.

wallet.removeAddressConfirm: Its balances stop counting in the wallet's value from the next read. The values already recorded stay.
wallet.syncQueued: Reading the balances again. The value follows once they are in.
